summary: Aclaris Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce positive Phase 1a SAD/MAD trial results for its anti-TSLP/IL-4R bispecific antibody ATI-052 and selection of lichen planus as lead indication for its ITK/JAK3 inhibitor ATI-2138, along with a conference call and presentation. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical data and pipeline updates, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic reviews are involved. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring activity.
